scope: Mocked Docker classification/cleanup/retained lifecycle only; no runtime or image loader qualification

review.method: Independent read-only review of full patch and pure scenarios; no runtime starts

policy: Known container ID preferred over name. Exact sole rc1 NoSuchObject/Container response proves absence; daemon errors, mixed text, wrong ID, generic nonzero do not.
Initial inspect is inside cleanup/reset guard; independent own-name/ID cleanup and final classified inspect run after errors. Original failure propagates even if cleanup later proves absence.
Known foreign inspected objects are not removed. Unknown cleanup remains recorded and blocks repeated stop and replacement argv; handles reset.
Actual successful image hardkill path still requires live exact owned image/container, KILL/wait137/nonrunning137/removal/independent absence; cold replacement disarms observer.
